description.narrative: This project contributes to the programme by enhancing access to financial resources for climate action. The project will support small and other vulnerable states to improve their access to various sources of climate funding by providing technical assistance on the development and submission of climate finance project pipelines, concept notes and proposals, institutional strengthening including accreditation and readiness support, capacity building through dedicated training activities, knowledge management and learning as well as mainstreaming of youth and gender considerations. By leveraging diverse sources of climate funding, the Secretariat will support member countries to accelerate climate action.
